decks.notes: This Modern Eldrazi Control deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Utopia Sprawl and Talismans, while playing disruptive spells like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble to control the board. The deck aims to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Ancient Stirrings and Sowing Mycospawn helps to ensure consistency in finding key pieces and providing card advantage. The deck's strategy revolves around overpowering the opponent with large threats while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells and removing threats, while also utilizing powerful card draw and manipulation effects. The key strategy is to establish board control through a combination of countermagic and removal spells, while using Tamiyo, Teferi, and The One Ring to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Timeless Dragon. The goal is to grind out incremental advantages and win through attrition.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to accelerate into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, which can close out the game quickly. The deck also includes cards like All Is Dust and Devourer of Destiny to deal with threats from the opponent. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using powerful Eldrazi creatures and artifacts while assembling UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate large amounts of mana. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Karn, the Great Creator, while also having access to board wipes like All Is Dust. The deck also includes a strong late-game plan with big threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and World Breaker. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures helps to protect key spells from counterspells.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Goryo's Vengeance. By combining instant reanimation with cards that can protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's strategy, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures like Ulamog, the Defiler. The deck also includes various control elements and card draw to ensure consistency in executing the combo. Overall, the strategy revolves around setting up a quick and decisive win condition through instant reanimation and powerful creature threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive, fast-paced gameplay with a mix of creatures, removal spells, and card advantage. The goal is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan and Phlage, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional reach and flexibility in dealing with threats. The companion choice of Jegantha adds consistency and a powerful late-game option. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and close out games swiftly.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. It also utilizes powerful creatures such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Boggart Trawler to maintain control of the battlefield. The deck can generate advantage with cards like Necrodominance and Fell the Profane, while also having removal options like Fatal Push. The inclusion of Agadeem's Awakening as a land helps to bring back key creatures from the graveyard. The overall strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and dominating the game with strong control elements.

The key concept of this deck is to use control elements such as counterspells and board wipes to disrupt your opponent's strategy while building up to play The One Ring, a powerful win condition that can dominate the game. The deck also includes versatile removal options like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, as well as card draw engines like Consign to Memory and Nulldrifter to ensure consistency and resilience. By controlling the game and leveraging the strength of The One Ring, you can outvalue and outlast your opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of ramp, removal, and powerful Eldrazi creatures. The main goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while consistently playing threats like Emrakul and World Breaker to close out the game. With cards like Ancient Stirrings and Eldrazi Temple to help accelerate mana production, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and disruptive abilities. The synergy between Kozilek's Return, Malevolent Rumble, and Devourer of Destiny provides a strong control element, allowing the deck to dictate the pace of the game.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through rituals and medallions to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. It utilizes Wish to access specific cards from the sideboard and has cards like Glimpse the Impossible for card advantage. The goal is to create a storm of spells, resulting in a massive amount of damage or card advantage in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent and winning the game quickly. The deck also includes some land destruction and mana fixing elements to ensure consistency in its combo strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's actions through counterspells and removal, while also utilizing card advantage with effects like Snapcaster Mage. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board until it can finish the game with powerful finishers like Flame of Anor or Thundertrap Trainer. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and allow for flexibility in casting spells at different points in the game. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining control and out-valuing the opponent.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It includes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Curiosity to accelerate mana production. Control elements such as Spell Snare and Malevolent Rumble are used to disrupt opponents' strategies. All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return provide board wipes to clear the way for big creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and control spells.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor to put pressure on the opponent early on. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant help deal direct damage and remove threats from the opponent. Additionally, cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison disrupt the opponent's mana base and strategy. The overall strategy is to be fast and aggressive, while also having disruption to control the game.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on generating aggressive pressure through creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters, supported by powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment. It also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Static Prison to control the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Marsh Flats, along with dual lands like Sacred Foundry and Godless Shrine to ensure smooth and efficient gameplay.

This deck aims to quickly flood the board with cheap creatures and large threats like Hollow One and Nethergoyf while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Goblin Lore and Burning Inquiry. Utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Dragon's Rage Channeler to draw cards and pump up creatures, this deck looks to apply immense pressure early on and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of strong removal like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt helps to clear the way for your creatures to attack freely.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by playing efficient threats like Murktide Regent while also maintaining control of the board through cards like Fatal Push and Archmage's Charm. By using a mix of permission spells and card draw, the deck seeks to slow down the opponent's strategy and eventually take over the game with powerful creatures and spells.
